sql.processStepAction.getActionsForStep: select psa.*, cpsst.id as company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, at.action_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(logic))) FROM ( SELECT psl.id, psl.archived, psl.process_step_requirement_id as "processStepRequirementId", psl.operation_type_id as "operationTypeId", ot.operation_type as "operationType", ot.operation_code as "operationCode", psl.created_by_id as "createdById", psl.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psr.requirement_nbr as "requirementNbr", psr.immutable as "processStepRequirementImmutable", psl.sql_order as "sqlOrder" FROM flow.process_step_logic psl left join flow.operation_type ot on ot.id = psl.operation_type_id left join flow.process_step_requirement psr on psr.id = psl.process_step_requirement_id WHERE psl.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psl.archived is not true ORDER BY psl.sql_order ) logic), '[]') AS "processStepLogicList", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(children))) FROM ( SELECT psacp.id, psacp.archived, psacp.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psacp.process_step_id as "processStepId", psacp.trigger_automatically as "triggerAutomatically", psacp.display_order as "displayOrder", psacp.created_by_id as "createdById", psacp.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", ps.process_step_name as "processStepName" FROM flow.process_step_action_child_process psacp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psacp.process_step_id WHERE psacp.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psacp.archived is not true order by psacp.display_order, ps.process_step_name ) children), '[]') AS "processStepActionChildProcesses", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT psal.id, psal.archived, psal.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psal.created_by_id as "createdById", psal.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", l.link, l.url FROM flow.process_step_action_link psal inner join flow.link l on l.id = psal.link_id WHERE psal.process_step_action_id = psa.id and psal.archived is not true order by l.link ) links), '[]') AS "processStepActionLinks" from flow.process_step_action psa left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = psa.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.action_type at on at.id = psa.action_type_id where case when :processStepId::integer is not null then psa.process_step_id = :processStepId else 1 = 1 end and case when :id::integer is not null then psa.id = :id else 1 = 1 end and psa.archived is not true order by psa.action_name
sql.processStepAction.deleteAction: update flow.process_step_action set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :actionId
sql.processStepAction.updateAction: update flow.process_step_action set action_name = :actionName, action_type_id = :actionTypeId, company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.insertAction: insert into flow.process_step_action(process_step_id, action_name, action_type_id, company_process_step_status_type_id, created_by_id, archived) values (:processStepId, :actionName, :actionTypeId, :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, :createdById, false)
sql.processStepAction.insertLogic: insert into flow.process_step_logic (process_step_requirement_id, operation_type_id, sql_order, process_step_action_id, date_created, created_by_id) values (:processStepRequirementId, :operationTypeId, :sqlOrder, :id, now(), :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getChildProcessStepsFo: select ps.* from flow.process_step ps where ps.id != :stepId and ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true and not exists ( select acp.process_step_action_id from flow.process_step_action_child_process acp where acp.process_step_id = ps.id and acp.process_step_action_id = :actionId and acp.archived is not true ) order by ps.process_step_name
sql.processStepAction.addChildStepToAction: insert into flow.process_step_action_child_process (process_step_action_id, process_step_id, trigger_automatically, display_order, created_by_id) values (:processStepActionId, :processStepId, :triggerAutomatically, :displayOrder, :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getActionChildStep: select cp.id, cp.process_step_action_id, cp.process_step_id, cp.trigger_automatically, cp.display_order, cp.archived, cp.date_created, cp.date_modified, cp.created_by_id, cp.modified_by_id, ps.process_step_name from flow.process_step_action_child_process cp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cp.process_step_id where cp.id = :id
sql.processStepAction.deleteActionChildStep: update flow.process_step_action_child_process set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.updateActionChildStep: update flow.process_step_action_child_process set trigger_automatically = :triggerAutomatically, display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.addLinkToAction: insert into flow.process_step_action_link (process_step_action_id, link_id, created_by_id) values (:processStepActionId, :linkId, :createdById)
sql.processStepAction.getActionChildLink: select psal.id, psal.process_step_action_id, psal.link_id, psal.archived, psal.created_by_id, psal.date_created, psal.modified_by_id, psal.date_modified, l.link, l.url from flow.process_step_action_link psal inner join flow.link l on l.id = psal.link_id where psal.id = :id
sql.processStepAction.deleteLinkFromAction: update flow.process_step_action_link set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
